project_type: Flutter mobile app (RepGate/HealthPush) - health tracker with push-up enforced app locking, backed by Supabase
build_system: Flutter SDK >=3.32.0, Dart >=3.5.0. Uses --dart-define for config.
test_framework: flutter_test (dev dependency) but no test files found in repo
build_command: flutter analyze (static analysis only, no full build available in sandbox)
verification_instructions: Run flutter analyze to validate no compile errors; since Flutter SDK may not be available in sandbox, verify via manual code review of Dart syntax correctness.
setup_instructions: Flutter SDK required but likely not available in sandbox. Validate changes through static code review.
environment_constraints: Network is likely limited (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY). Flutter SDK not installed. Verification is through static Dart code correctness review only.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Key rules from context: do NOT modify database schema, payment/UPI logic, or push-up anti-cheat logic. Leave TODO comments for risky issues.
key_patterns: Provider for state management. Services are stateless facades registered via MultiProvider. Models have fromMap/toMap factories. Screens use context.watch/select for rebuilds. SoftCard + PillButton widgets for consistent UI. AppSpacing/AppColors/AppRadius from utils/app_theme.dart.
directory_structure: lib/ contains main.dart, supabase_config.dart, models/ (11 model files), providers/ (health_provider, user_provider), services/ (auth, firestore, food, fine, pushup, notification, platform_channel, dataset, app_settings, supabase_client), screens/ (admin, auth, blocked_apps, fines, food, home, profile, pushup, reports, settings, water, weight), widgets/ (11 reusable widgets), utils/ (app_theme, constants, helpers)
